info.name: Mehnaty API
info.description:
All Mehnaty backend endpoints (Django REST API).

How to use:
1. Start the app (start.bat). Note the API port it prints.
2. Import this collection and the "Mehnaty Local" environment. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8000/api).
3. Run "Auth > Login" first. It saves the access/refresh tokens automatically; every other request uses them.
4. Change the IDs in the URLs/bodies (offer_id, order id, ...) to IDs that exist in your database.

Demo accounts (only after start.bat -Demo): customer@demo.mehnaty.test, embroidery@demo.mehnaty.test (business), supplier@demo.mehnaty.test, admin@demo.mehnaty.test. Password: DEMO_PASSWORD in backend/core/management/commands/seed_demo.py.

item.name: 0. Quick check (read-only)
item.description: Safe requests to confirm the API works. They do not change data.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Register, login and account. Login saves tokens into collection variables.

request.description: Set the collection variables "email" and "password" first.

Street-level parts are optional, but at least one of street / landmark / details is required. latitude+longitude form an optional exact map pin (both or neither; stored rounded to 6 decimals). Response includes full_text and map_url.

body.raw:
{
  "label": "Workshop",
  "recipient_name": "Sara",
  "phone": "0590000000",
  "city": 1,
  "area": null,
  "street": "Rafidia Street",
  "building": "12",
  "floor": "3",
  "apartment": "5",
  "landmark": "Opposite the girls school",
  "details": "Green door",
  "latitude": 32.2211,
  "longitude": 35.2544
}

exec: pm.test('address created with map link', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().map_url).to.include('google.com/maps'); });

request.description: Send latitude:null and longitude:null to remove the pin. Existing orders keep their own copy of the address.
fulfillment: pickup | delivery (delivery needs address_id). All items must belong to one business.
target_type: review | offer | business | material | supplier

request.description: Next: preparing -> ready -> completed (pickup) or in_transit -> completed (delivery). Or rejected / cancelled.
status: created | picked_up | in_transit | delivered | failed | returned
category: packaging | delivery | commission | materials_used | other
period: day | week | month, or use from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD
unit: piece | meter | kg | gram | pack | roll | liter | box. category must be a material category.
Next: preparing -> shipped. Or rejected / cancelled.
